wholePhysicalScope: OpenStreetMap way 296923182 supplies the 18-point cruciform perimeter, including the west tower. The landmark nomination establishes the 23-foot walls and approximately 100-foot steeple.
lodDetails: Every level retains the mapped cruciform plan, layered steeple, shingled roof silhouette and south entry. Nearer levels restore the arched opening grids, eave blocks and belfry louvers.
limitations: The April 2007 public-domain Qualla exterior establishes the south façade, rounded openings, weathered Flemish-bond brick, contrasting plum tower and two pale octagonal steeple stages.
The landmark nomination gives the documented wall and overall steeple heights. The roof pitch, intermediate tower sections, rear openings and entry steps are proportional estimates.
The original terrain field supplies the south threshold datum. The street, churchyard enclosure, memorials, trees and interior are outside the model.
The geometry and shared surface materials are original. No reference pixels are embedded.
